title: Pixel Doodle
description: An offline pixel-art editor and animation tool for DS, DSi and 3DS.
long_description: Pixel Doodle is an offline pixel-art editor and animation tool for the Nintendo DS, DSi and 3DS. It supports canvases up to 512 px, eight layers, 256 frames, tags, linked cels, onion skin, Aseprite import/export, PNG import/export and a full set of drawing, selection, colour and palette tools.
